mkp-learn:quiz.cloze@1.name: quiz.cloze
mkp-learn:quiz.cloze@1.about: Fill in the blanks: text pieces and fields flowing as one paragraph, checked as exact text (with other spellings that count), numbers or expressions. One blank and no text is a short answer: a word, a name.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.about: the question or instruction above the text

inputs.name: pieces
inputs.about: each piece is some text, followed by a blank when it has an answer; also lists other spellings that count

inputs.name: match
inputs.about: how a blank is checked

inputs.name: vars
inputs.about: the variables, when match is expression

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.about: how close counts, when match is number

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: the caption before the title: what the question belongs to (Quiz, Practice)

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the header's title, what the reader does; empty: Fill in the blanks, or Type it for a single blank

inputs.name: help
inputs.about: under the prompt, small: how to answer

inputs.name: praise
inputs.about: what the verdict says when every blank is right; empty: the answers

inputs.name: wrongs
inputs.about: known wrong entries (in any blank) and why

inputs.name: next
inputs.about: the caller's own buttons, after the question's in its bar (a set's Next)

signals.name: answered
signals.about: sent on every check, with every blank's entry

values.name: lone
comment: a single blank with no text around it is a short answer, given a wide field
